text:
olivia: Hi @auditor_elise — quick followup on the RBAC change evidence you requested. We can provide rolebinding snapshots, compact audit log samples, and the KMS key-access graph. What exact sample window do you need and do you want hashed user IDs or full principals?

auditor_elise: Hi Olivia — thanks. Need a 30-day window centered around the change (7 days before, 23 after). Hashed user IDs are fine but we need deterministic mapping for verification. Also need proof of key usage for KMS for the specific deploys (key version, envelope ID).

raj: We ran the RBAC rollout last week. I can export rolebinding snapshots from the cluster and the IAM audit events. Prefer to share hashed IDs; we can provide a salt per export for mapping. Is that acceptable?

auditor_elise: Deterministic salt per export is fine. Also need timeline: who initiated the change, approval flow (PR + approvers), and CI deploy traces.

olivia: OK. I'll assemble the rolebinding diff, approval PR thread link, and the deploy pipeline run IDs. @sam can you dump the kube-audit samples and the S3 presigned bundle link?

sam: On it. Will prepare a compressed bundle with paths:
- /audit/k8s/2026-10/rolebindings.jsonl.gz
- /audit/iam/2026-10/iam_events.jsonl.gz
I'll strip pod-level sensitive fields and include a manifest with checksums. Upload ETA ~2h.

auditor_elise: Please ensure we can link a KMS decrypt/encrypt event to the exact deploy timestamp. We need the KMS key version and envelope key ID.

raj: KMS logs show Encrypt/Decrypt events. We also have CMK ARN and key version in the envelope metadata. I can correlate with the deploy IDs. Caveat: decrypt events are logged with principal service-account@redwood-inference; we'll include a mapping file for human principals.

security-bot: Reminder: for exports containing hashed PII use the compliance-approved scrubbing script v2.1. Run: ./tools/scrub_exports.sh --salt=YYYYMMDD-salt :lock:

maria: Adding: include chain-of-custody info — who pulled the bundle, checksum, presigned URL expiry, and the internal ticket that authorized the export. For SOC2 provide a short statement of sampling methodology.

olivia: Drafting the export now. Quick Q: for RBAC snapshots do auditors accept "kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml" per-namespace, or prefer aggregated JSON diffs?

auditor_elise: Aggregated diffs are preferable for initial review, but keep original manifests too. We may request raw per-namespace yamls for deeper verification.

sam: Also note: some ephemeral serviceaccounts created during the rollout will be obfuscated. We'll list obfuscated IDs in the manifest with rationale and original-create-timestamp.

raj: For vulnerability triage, we flagged a sidecar image with CVE-2025-9988 around the same time. Do you need the vuln triage notes included?

auditor_elise: Yes include the triage summary and mitigation evidence. If the vuln overlapped with the RBAC change window, explicitly call it out and provide any rollback or patch PRs.

olivia: Good catch. I'll bundle triage notes, PRs for the fix, and deployment rollback logs if any.

maria: For packaging, I'll create a compliance cover letter PDF mapping control IDs (SOC2 CC6.1, CC7.1) to exported artifacts and listing sample selection rules.

auditor_elise: One last ask: can you provide a replayable query/command for us to re-run the sampling selection so it's deterministic? We prefer a short README with exact commands and the salt used.

olivia: We'll include exact CLI commands and query filters. Example we will include (parameterized timestamps):
```
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /k8s/audit --start-time 1699990000000 --end-time 1700584800000 --filter-pattern "RoleBinding" > rolebinding_events.jsonl
```
and the jq filters we used to produce the diff.

sam: Uploading now. I'll ping when the bundle is available and attach the manifest + salt file.

security-bot: Export uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-exports/1901234560/rbac-snapshot-bundle-2026-10-05.tar.gz :lock: (expires in 7 days)

olivia: Received, thanks @sam. @auditor_elise we'll DM you the presigned link and the salt file out-of-band. Anything else before we close this thread?

auditor_elise: No that's it for now. Might follow up with one or two small requests after review. Thanks everyone.
